en: Repaired release-note control-character handling, published a manually verified unsigned Squirrel.Windows release, and read all three assets back against the canonical build hashes.
yue: 修正 release notes 控制字元問題，手動發佈並驗證未簽署 Squirrel.Windows release，再下載三件資產逐個對返 canonical build 雜湊。

en: Corrected renderer-to-engine and renderer-to-interface state mappings, restored generated nature content, and aligned the bridge declarations used by the published desktop build.
yue: 修正 renderer 去引擎同介面嘅狀態映射、補回生成式自然內容，並對齊已發佈桌面版本使用嘅 bridge 宣告。

en: Material Design 3 interface: HUD, every game panel, settings surface, language modes, search with regex builders, notifications, and the destructive-action confirmation gate.
yue: Material Design 3 介面：HUD、每個遊戲面板、設定畫面、語言模式、帶規律建構器嘅搜尋、通知，同破壞性動作確認關卡。

en: Headless simulation integrated: tick, offline resume, save schema, fields, animals, factories, the four consumers, town, zoo, mine, boosters, achievements, dailies, and the local village.
yue: 無畫面模擬系統整合完成：tick、離線推進、存檔格式、田地、動物、工廠、四大消耗途徑、小鎮、動物園、礦場、加速道具、成就、每日任務，同本機村莊。

en: Generative three.js engine integrated: mesh DSL, semantic palette, buildings, nature, props and characters — every asset built in code, no texture files.
yue: 生成式 three.js 引擎整合完成：mesh DSL、語意色板、建築、自然景物、道具同角色——所有素材都用程式碼生成，冇貼圖檔。

en: Foundation lane integrated: workspace, TypeScript, Electron shell, unsigned Squirrel.Windows packaging, one-click build scripts, release workflow, line counter, completeness inventory, and the Windows-safe atomic-write helper.
yue: 地基分支整合完成：工作區、TypeScript、Electron 外殼、未簽署嘅 Squirrel.Windows 封裝、一鍵編譯腳本、發佈工作流程、行數計算器、完整度清單，同 Windows 安全嘅原子寫入輔助工具。

en: Added the release line counter, the feature-completeness inventory, and a guard that refuses a bare fs.rename anywhere in the tree.
yue: 加咗發佈行數計算器、功能完整度清單，同一個唔畀成個 repo 出現裸 fs.rename 嘅檢查工具。

en: Wrote the full design and delivery plan (docs/PLAN.md) before any gameplay code — the source of truth every other lane, and this site, builds from.
yue: 喺未寫任何玩法程式碼之前，先寫低成套設計同交付計劃（docs/PLAN.md）——之後每個分支同呢個網站，都係跟呢份文件起。

en: Laid the workspace foundation: npm workspaces for shared, engine, ui and app packages.
yue: 鋪好工作區地基：shared、engine、ui 同 app 幾個套件用 npm workspaces 連埋。
